claude.result:
I fixed it: `frai gate init --ci` now creates `.github/workflows/rai-gate.yml`. I only changed the `frai` CLI; `packages/frai-gate` is untouched.

**Cause:** The top-level `frai` command has its own `--ci` option (`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts:605`). By default, Commander (the command-line parsing library) matches top-level options wherever they appear. So `--ci` was taken by `frai` itself and never forwarded to `frai-gate`, which just ran `init` without it. There was no error because `--ci` is a valid `frai` option.

**Fix** (two lines in `src/index.ts`):
- I added `.enablePositionalOptions()` to the top-level program, so its options only count when they come before the subcommand name.
- I added `.passThroughOptions()` to the `gate` command, so everything after `gate` goes to `frai-gate` unchanged.

**Checks:**
- **Before the fix:** in an empty folder, only `FRAI-SPEC.md` was created, as reported.
- **Build:** `pnpm --filter frai build` succeeded.
- **After the fix:** in a new empty folder, both `FRAI-SPEC.md` and `.github/workflows/rai-gate.yml` were created, and I confirmed the workflow file exists.
- **Other commands:** `frai --version`, `frai gate check --help` (passed on to `frai-gate`) and `frai scan --ci --json` still work.
- **Tests:** `vitest` found no test files in this package, so I didn't add a test. I deleted the temporary test folders afterwards.

**Side effect:** a top-level-only option placed after a subcommand that doesn't define it, like `frai setup --ci`, now fails with an "unknown option" error. Before, it was silently ignored.

Changed files: `src/index.ts` and the rebuilt `dist/index.js`. Nothing is committed.
